CLIP is the official OG Mascot of $AMC

CLIP is anthropomorphic film strip character introduced in 1991.

AMC created him as the brand ambassador, he was displayed before before every movie as their mascot. He showed up in pre-show animations, theater decorations, concessions promotions, like “Clip’s Picks”, and even as a somewhat creepy costume mascot at events.

As we all know, AMC stock has always been the memestock back in the day in parallel with GME.

In other words, one of the most known memestock companies in history has a mascot that has gone unnoticed.

raw.githubusercontent.com

opm.gov

.gov domains can only be registered by verified U.S. government entities, so this is not a scam or unofficial lookalike site. If the site goes live later, it would likely relate to workforce, apprenticeship, or jobs initiatives under the current administration. Always type official URLs directly rather than clicking links from emails or ads, and confirm any job application process through known government sites like USAJOBS.gov.
